name: convention-yaml-configuration-document
description: A configuration file an applied row reads whose name ends with .yml or .yaml is read as the document its YAML text denotes, so a package its prefixed-name property or its package key names there is used, while a declared dependency it names nowhere is reported. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named eslint for the package eslint, holding the installed version in its range, that reads .eslintrc.yml, whose plugins property names packages by the eslint-plugin prefix and whose parser member is a package key.
